title: Solar Foods Oyj Financial statements release 2025 (unaudited)
theme: precision fermentation / gas fermentation single-cell protein (Solein)

findings.claim: Factory 01 (Vantaa, Finland) reached the productivity parameters (1 g/l/h; O2/CO2 energy value 2.7) enabling it to operate at its full DESIGN capacity of 160 tonnes of Solein per year; this is a 100-fold scale-up vs pilot
findings.locator: Financial statements release 2025, Report of Board of Directors, 'During the review period ... achieved its design capacity of 160 tonnes per year' (p.4 bullet + body ~l.147-149)
findings.systemBoundary: DESIGN capacity reached / nameplate — NOT a measured actual annual produced tonnage; report states capacity achieved, not tonnes output for the year

findings.claim: Revenue for the FY2025 review period (year ending 31.12.2025) was EUR 0.1 million (prior year 0); company states it does not expect significant revenue before Factory 02 is deployed
findings.locator: Financial statements release 2025, 'Revenue for the review period was EUR 0.1 million (0)' (~l.186/209)
findings.systemBoundary: audited-basis financial figure (release marked unaudited); indicates negligible ACTUAL commercial Solein volume delivered despite 160 t design capacity

findings.claim: Two MoUs signed for commercialization of a total annual Solein production volume of 6.5-7.65 kilotonnes, ~100-120% of the PLANNED 6.4-kilotonne capacity of the future Factory 02 facility (Lappeenranta)
findings.systemBoundary: PLANNED capacity (Factory 02 not built) + non-binding MoU volume intent — not produced

notMeasured: actual tonnes of Solein produced during 2025
actual tonnes sold/delivered (only EUR 0.1m revenue given)
limitations: Release marked unaudited; company is pre-commercial and reports capacity milestones rather than realised production volumes

title: Offshoring insect farms may jeopardize Europe's food sovereignty
theme: insect protein (feed) — actual vs projected European production

findings.claim: IPIFF's members produced around 9,500 tonnes of insect feed products in 2022 (reported figure cited in a peer-reviewed CC-BY article, Global Sustainability 7, e31)
findings.locator: Ryba 2024, sec.2, '~9,500 tonnes of insect feed' (body ~l.79)
findings.systemBoundary: IPIFF member firms' self-reported feed output for 2022 (association-membership scope, not whole EU market); reproduced in peer-reviewed source

findings.claim: IPIFF had projected annual insect-protein production would reach 1 million tonnes by 2025 and 3 million tonnes by 2030; author notes ~100-fold growth would be required and this is not on track
findings.systemBoundary: PROJECTION / target, explicitly contrasted with ~9,500 t actual — quantifies the paper-capacity vs actual gap

findings.claim: Forecasting platform Metaculus predicts ~47,000 tonnes of insect protein used as animal feed in Europe by 2028
Estimated labour cost of 677-2913 EUR per tonne of production reported for seven Tenebrio molitor farms in the Netherlands
findings.systemBoundary: cost estimate per tonne, NL mealworm farms

notMeasured: independently measured production volumes for individual named companies (Ynsect, InnovaFeed, Protix given qualitatively only)
limitations: Actual-production figure originates from IPIFF self-reporting; projections are targets/forecasts

source: IPIFF (International Platform of Insects for Food and Feed), 2025
title: The state of the European insect food production sector and future perspectives — IPIFF Survey: Main Findings Report
theme: insect protein for human food — sector survey

findings.claim: Total production of insects for human consumption (whole, powder and lipids) in 2023 was 802.65 tonnes across the 19 responding EU insect-farming companies, up from 2022
findings.locator: IPIFF Food-Market 2025, Ch.II sec.IV 'total production ... in 2023 was 802,65 tonnes'
findings.systemBoundary: self-reported survey; scope = 19 responding EU firms, insect food (human) only, not feed and not whole market

findings.claim: Total collective production of insects for human consumption in 2022 was 328.27 tonnes (stated in Ch.II sec.II); note the same report elsewhere cites 'over 474,38 tonnes' for 2022 as the comparison base — an internal inconsistency
findings.locator: IPIFF Food-Market 2025, Ch.II sec.II vs sec.IV comparison line
findings.systemBoundary: self-reported survey, human-food insects; two conflicting 2022 figures in the same document — flag before use

findings.claim: Species mix among responding food producers: yellow mealworm 50%, house cricket 33.3%, migratory locust 8.3%, other 8.3%; ~68% of respondents' main activity is primary production/breeding
findings.locator: IPIFF Food-Market 2025, Ch.II sec.I; Ch.I sec.I

limitations: Small self-selected sample (19 firms); internally inconsistent 2022 figure; excludes feed segment

source: ENORM BioFactory A/S statutory accounts (via proff.dk), 2024
title: ENORM BioFactory A/S — Danish statutory annual accounts (CVR 38847147), FY2021-2023
theme: black soldier fly (Hermetia illucens) insect protein/oil/fertiliser — Nordic producer financials

findings.claim: ENORM BioFactory A/S reported a loss (arets resultat) of DKK -31.3m in 2023 (2022: -12.4m; 2021: -5.2m); net revenue (omsaetning) is NOT disclosed in the public accounts for any year; employees 26 (2023)
findings.locator: proff.dk regnskab, ENORM BioFactory A/S, arets resultat by year
findings.systemBoundary: audited statutory financial result; turnover suppressed so ACTUAL production/sales value cannot be read from accounts

findings.claim: The ~10,000 tonnes/year of insect meal (plus ~2,500 t oil, ~15,000 t fertiliser) widely cited for ENORM is the plant's DESIGN capacity (factory opened early 2024); no produced-volume figure appears in the statutory accounts, and FY2024 (first production year) accounts were unavailable at retrieval
findings.locator: proff.dk company description + staged note; capacity per company/press announcements
findings.systemBoundary: DESIGN capacity / nameplate — explicitly NOT measured produced volume; confirms the R2 concern that Enorm's tonnage is paper capacity

limitations: proff.dk is a secondary aggregator; underlying primary is the CVR-filed arsrapport (queued for direct retrieval). Turnover legally suppressed.
